title: Read a labelled neural-tube section

regions.label: Neural lumen
regions.observation: Central dark space bordered by labelled wall.
regions.interpretation: The provider identifies a chick neural tube; the lumen-facing surface is apical.
regions.limit: Do not assign dorsal/ventral identity from this isolated field.

regions.label: Apical red-labelled region
regions.observation: Red signal near the luminal edge.
regions.interpretation: Provider associates this channel with phospho-H3 and mitotic figures
regions.limit: A red spot alone is not a complete cell boundary or a speed measurement.

regions.label: Green-labelled outer wall
regions.observation: Green signal farther from the lumen in this region.
regions.interpretation: Provider associates green labelling with BrdU incorporation

regions.label: Blue nuclear distribution
regions.observation: Blue-labelled nuclei occur at different wall depths.
regions.interpretation: The provider identifies DAPI-labelled DNA; nuclear positions do not outline complete cells.
regions.limit: Nuclear rows alone cannot establish cell layering or lineage.

model: I see a central dark lumen and a densely nucleated wall. The provider identifies a chick neural tube. Red phospho-H3-associated signal lies near the luminal edge and green BrdU-associated signal occurs farther out in the selected region. The labels support spatial and labelling relationships, not a measured movement rate or a lineage history. Exact stage, pulse/chase interval, physical scale and dorsal/ventral orientation remain unresolved in this field.
